newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Fargo estimate reduced.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Fargo estimate reduced.

text.p: -- Keefe Bruyette & Woods analyst David Berry said he reduced his full year 1996 earnings per share estimate for Wells Fargo to $14.50 a share from $15.80.

-- He said the revision reflects merger-related transitional costs in the third quarter, reported on October 15, anticipated transitional expenses in the fourth quarter and reinitiation of a loan loss provision in the third quarter, which should continue to rise through the third quarter of 1997.
